result.reason: The redline addresses affiliate and contractor use in the grant and paragraph (e), but paragraph (b) still prohibits disclosure or access by any third party without consent, which conflicts with access by affiliates and contractors. It also adds none of the required protections for perpetual and irrevocable paid-up licences, termination of subscription licences only for uncured material breach, or transfer to a successor. It therefore meets neither the preferred position nor the fallback, which requires transferability in an M&A transaction. The unrelated Field of Use and payment limitations are preserved, but the unnecessary reordering of paragraphs and unresolved internal inconsistency undermine minimality and drafting quality. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions.
